youtube.title: Why does fabric softener ruin your towels? 🧺 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Fabric softener works by depositing a thin, slightly waxy layer of lubricating compounds on fibers, which makes cloth feel smooth. On towels, that coating repels water so the loops absorb less. Towels washed without softener usually stay more absorbent.
